result.brief: 提出统一多模态多参考视频编辑框架，用参考库接口与R²-RoPE支持可变数量文本/图像/视频参考，并以单流扩散Transformer联合处理源视频与MLLM多模态上下文，同时构建数据与基准。
result.reason: Unified multimodal multi-reference video editing with single-stream diffusion transformer, reference-bank input design and R²-RoPE for reference generalization; directly a video editing/generation contribution.
